patches.title: Safely decode interlaced 16-to-8-bit reads and preserve Adam7 accumulation
patches.description: Backports the final upstream CVE-2025-65018 implementation and its CVE-2026-22695 bounds correction, with the accumulated-row correction reported in upstream issue #853.

dep3.origin: Backport of upstream commits 218612d and e4f7ad4, plus the Adam7 accumulated-row correction reported in upstream issue #853.

tests.runner: getpatched/platform:verification/regression.py (read-interlaced-rgba.c with a guarded output buffer under Valgrind)
tests.baselineExpectation: The exact installed Focal 1.6.37-2 library overwrites the sentinel region beyond PNG_IMAGE_SIZE for the 32x32 RGB16 Adam7 to RGBA8 read and reports result=overrun:output-buffer.
tests.patchedExpectation: The exact installed patched library reports result=within-output-buffer; its separate Adam7 comparison also preserves decoded pixel values.

tests.baselineExpectation: On the exact vulnerable source, reading these equivalent Adam7 and flat 16-bit RGB fixtures to 8-bit RGB yields identical pixels.
tests.patchedExpectation: The installed patched library preserves the same decoded pixels across all Adam7 passes; no channels differ from the flat reference.

tests.baselineExpectation: The vulnerable final-CVE patch sequence overreads local_row for padded stride or fails for negative stride under a memory checker.
tests.patchedExpectation: The installed patched library copies only the local row bytes and honors padded and negative caller strides without an out-of-bounds read.

patches.title: Preserve ptrdiff_t row strides in simplified PNG writes
patches.description: Backports upstream commit cf155de to avoid truncating large or negative row strides in the simplified write API.

dep3.origin: Backport of the upstream simplified-write row-stride fix.

tests.baselineExpectation: The Focal 1.6.37-2 source with Ubuntu's patch series overreads input while writing 16-bit linear RGBA rows with a negative row stride; this reproduces in the retained native source test.
tests.patchedExpectation: The same write call completes without an out-of-bounds read under a memory checker on the candidate source.
